title: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Larger-Class Partner Rental: Customer Acceptance Tool Card
content:
**Rule.** Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, a customer whose damaged vehicle is in the shop on an accepted physical damage claim may take a partner-agency car of a class above the option's direct-bill vehicle class. That rental is recorded as an authorization only when the customer personally accepts it. The customer pays the agency every amount above what the option pays for each day.

## What the acceptance records

Each acceptance records one rental authorization on the claim's rental ledger, as a Cardinal partner direct-bill rental. The authorization shows the car class taken, the pickup date, the agency's daily rate and the number of rental days authorized. A new rental authorization number is issued, and the customer and the agency use that number for the rental from then on.

## Tool and who runs it

The tool is `accept_upgraded_rental_aa4639f2`. It belongs to the customer. The representative unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, because the acceptance is the customer's own.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_coverage_id` | Reference number of the rental reimbursement option the rental is paid under, as given to the customer from the rental option lookup | Identifier |
| `customer_id` | Customer reference number of the named insured, as given to the customer from the profile lookup | Identifier |
| `claim_number` | Physical damage claim number of the loss the rental is for, as given to the customer from the claim lookup | Identifier |
| `vehicle_class` | Car class the customer is taking from the partner agency | One of `economy`, `compact`, `intermediate`, `standard`, `full_size`, `standard_suv`, `minivan`, `premium` |
| `start_date` | Date the customer picked the rental car up from the agency, as printed on the rental agreement | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `daily_rate` | Agency's daily rate for the car taken, taxes and fees included, as printed on the rental agreement | US dollars, 2 decimal places |
| `authorized_days` | Number of rental days the authorization covers | Whole number of days |

Car class values: `economy` is an economy car, `compact` a compact car, `intermediate` an intermediate car, `standard` a standard-size car, `full_size` a full-size car, `standard_suv` a standard SUV, `minivan` a minivan, and `premium` a premium car.

## Return

On success the tool returns the word "accepted" as the status, together with:
- the new rental authorization number issued for the rental;
- the reference number of the authorization entry on the rental ledger;
- the class recorded;
- the pickup date recorded (YYYY-MM-DD);
- the agency daily rate recorded (US dollars, 2 decimal places);
- the days authorized (a whole number).

## Basis Q&A

- *Who pays for the larger car?* The customer pays the agency every amount above what the option pays for each day.
- *Is the larger-class rental an authorization before the customer accepts it?* No. It is recorded as an authorization only when the customer personally accepts it.
